content.text: Question 1 is based on the following statement.

Mr. X is known as Father of Computer. He developed Analytical Machine in 1837 which has four main components, namely; memory, the mill, punch card reader and the punch and printed section. Analytical Machine is the successor of Y machine. Y machine is used to compute tables of numbers for naval navigation.
a) Name the inventor of Mr. X.
b) Identify the name of Y machine.
c) What is the function of Analytical Machine?
d) Map the components Analytical Machine to Von Neumann architecture
